# hibira_livechat_knowledge_source (Resource)

A website the AI assistant of a [Hibira Live Chat](https://chat.hibira.io) workspace answers from. Live Chat reads the site's `llms-full.txt`, `llms.txt` or sitemap (or the page itself) into the knowledge base and keeps it up to date; destroying the resource removes the entries read from it. The plan sets how many web pages can be read. Import with `<workspace_id>/<source id>`. Uses the provider's API token, which needs write access (and delete access to remove things) and an owner or admin of the workspace as its owner; the workspace's plan must include the API (Team and up). Needs a Hibira server with API tokens on Live Chat (pusher-server#898).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The AI assistant answers from the site's llms-full.txt, llms.txt or
# sitemap, kept up to date.
resource "hibira_livechat_knowledge_source" "help_center" {
  workspace_id = "ws_0123456789abcdef"
  url          = "https://help.example.com/"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `url` (String) The site's or page's https URL. Changing it replaces the source.
- `workspace_id` (String) The Live Chat workspace's ID (`ws_...`, in Live Chat's Settings, or `GET /v1/workspaces`). Changing it makes a new one there.

### Read-Only

- `found` (String) The file Live Chat read: the `llms-full.txt`, `llms.txt` or sitemap it found, or the page.
- `id` (String) The source's ID.
- `status` (String) `syncing`, `ok` or `failed`; reading a site takes a few minutes.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import hibira_livechat_knowledge_source.help_center ws_0123456789abcdef/src_0123456789
```
